items.title: PODCAST: Evaluating the Pacers’ first month as Haliburton nears a return
items.body_excerpt: On this episode of the Fieldhouse Files... I discuss the state of the Pacers one month into the season (6-12), the 3-point woes and inconsistent lineups. Plus, Tyrese Haliburton is nearing a return — and he shared some big news. Then, I'm joined by Jonathan Clark , a…
